root_idea.summary: The root centers on reddish coloration and the reddish light of dawn, extending to morning, morning activities, illumination, and brightness or beauty.
root_idea.development: The primary color association is explained as redness; dawn and the lamp are associated with this reddish light, from which meanings connected with morning, morning drink, waking, illumination, and facial brightness develop.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed as the normalized Form II verb صَبَّحَ.
Displayed as the normalized Form IV verb أَصْبَحَ.

The tag T occurrence is the same lexical item صُبْح in an adverbial accusative use.

Normalized from the Quran-only plural active participle مُصْبِحِينَ to the citation form مُصْبِح.

senses.definition: To come upon or visit someone in the morning; in a hostile context, to attack or seize at daybreak.
senses.usage_conditions: Used with a person, people, or place reached in the morning; the hostile sense is a conventional morning-raid use.

senses.definition: To enter upon the morning, or be present in a state reached by morning.
senses.usage_conditions: A temporal use referring to entering or reaching the morning; grammatical tense and person vary across the Quranic occurrences.

senses.definition: To become, come to be, or find oneself in a particular state or condition.
senses.usage_conditions: A non-attributive or incomplete-verb construction; the following predicate specifies the state, such as victory, grief, ruin, or another resulting condition.

senses.definition: To become engaged in or begin doing something.
senses.usage_conditions: Frequently followed by an imperfect verb, expressing becoming occupied with, setting about, or commencing an action.

senses.definition: Daybreak or the coming of morning.
senses.usage_conditions: A verbal noun of أَصْبَحَ used as a time expression for the onset of dawn.

senses.definition: Morning or forenoon, especially the early part of the day.
senses.usage_conditions: May be used as a time expression for the period beginning at dawn and extending into the morning or forenoon.

senses.definition: Daybreak, dawn, or the beginning of the day.
senses.usage_conditions: The noun denotes the onset or first part of daylight and may be used adverbially for the morning or dawn.

senses.definition: A lamp, especially its lighted wick or source of illumination.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic singular refers to a lamp or its illuminating wick; the plural may refer to several lamps.

senses.definition: A heavenly lamp or illuminating star; in the plural, the stars or heavenly lights.
senses.usage_conditions: Used in the plural for the lights set in the sky, understood as stars or celestial lamps rather than household lamps.

senses.definition: Entering upon or being present in the morning.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic form is the masculine plural active participle مُصْبِحِينَ, used adverbially or predicatively for people who are in, or arrive at, the morning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To give someone a morning draught, especially of milk or wine; also, to water camels in the morning.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The watering or drinking takes place between daybreak and sunrise.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be satiated or have one's thirst quenched by a morning draught.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Refers specifically to satisfaction obtained from the morning drink called صَبُوح.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To have hair in which whiteness is naturally mixed with redness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to hair or its coloration.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become beautiful, comely, elegant, or bright in the face.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The evidence especially associates the quality with the face, without making facial beauty the only possible application.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To greet someone with a morning blessing or wish for a good morning.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in formulas invoking goodness, happiness, or a pleasant morning for the person addressed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To travel by night and bring people to water in the morning.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative travel construction describing arrival at a water source by morning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To declare or tell the truth clearly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use meaning to make the truth plain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To awake or become roused from sleep; figuratively, to become alert from heedlessness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes imperative and proverbial uses urging someone to wake or recognize the proper course.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To perform the prayer of daybreak.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized religious use in the expression for performing the dawn prayer at its proper time.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To act gently.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare lexical use reported for the Form IV verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To trim or properly prepare a lamp or wick for use.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized verbal use concerning preparation of a lamp or wick.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To sleep in the morning or early part of the day.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The evidence places the sleep before sunrise or in the early morning; a related use refers to sleeping in the forenoon.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To eat food in the morning.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The food is a morning meal or صُبْحَة.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To affect or make a show of being beautiful or comely.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The form is explained as equivalent to affecting beauty.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To drink a morning draught.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The drink is the morning beverage called صَبُوح.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To light or use a lamp, wick, oil, or other material as a means of illumination.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May be used with بِ to express employing something for lighting oneself or others.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Truth or a clear, plain matter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use of the morning's clarity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A name for Mecca.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A proper-name usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The glistening of iron or another thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Refers to a bright or glistening appearance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Watering camels in the morning or early part of the day.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The evidence identifies this early watering, before sunrise, as a practice not regarded as wholesome by the Arabs.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The early forenoon or the period of entering upon morning.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May denote the time after sunrise, or more broadly one's entry into the morning or forenoon.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Sleep taken in the morning or early part of the day.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The evidence also extends the term by some usage to sleep in the forenoon.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Food eaten in the morning to satisfy or divert hunger.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Refers to morning food before sunrise or in the early part of the day.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who has drunk and been satisfied by a morning draught.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The feminine form may describe a she-camel milked in the morning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A she-camel that has been milked in the morning.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derived feminine designation associated with a morning milking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who hastens to take the morning draught.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Refers to eagerness to drink the beverage taken in the morning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A morning salutation or wish for a pleasant morning.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes the pre-Islamic greeting عِمْ صَبَاحًا and related formulas.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A morning hostile or predatory incursion; by extension, the day of such an attack.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression reflects the customary timing of raids at daybreak.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The flame or lighted wick of a lamp.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized noun for a lamp's lighted element.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A morning draught or beverage, especially milk or wine, taken before noon.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term is the opposite of غَبُوق and may refer generally to what is eaten or drunk in the morning; one authority also uses it absolutely for wine.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The quantity of milk drawn from a camel at dawn or in the early morning.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A measure or amount associated with the morning milking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A she-camel milked at dawn or in the morning.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized animal designation derived from the time of milking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Beautiful, comely, pretty, elegant, or bright in the face.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The evidence especially associates this adjective with the face or facial brightness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Beauty, comeliness, elegance, or brightness of the face.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A quality principally located in the face, distinguished in the cited lexical account from other aspects of beauty.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Intensely red blood.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized color adjective derived from the redness associated with the root.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An adjective applied to a wide spearhead.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression for wide spearheads; the lexical motivation is uncertain in the cited evidence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who gives a morning draught or waters camels in the morning.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An active participle of the Form I morning-drink or morning-watering use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who makes a hostile or predatory incursion in the morning.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension from giving a morning draught to making a morning attack.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Plain, manifest, or clear truth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression for truth that is clear or openly apparent.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Black with redness intermixed, or hair or a beard overspread with a reddish hue; also an epithet for a lion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The color description applies to people, lions, and hair; the lion designation is an associated lexical use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A woman conspicuous, clear, or fair in the forehead.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A feminine color or appearance adjective referring specifically to the forehead.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A whip associated with Dhu Asbah of Himyar.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A relational adjective referring to the named Yemeni king.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An adjective applied to certain wide spearheads.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression for wide spearheads; the exact motivation is reported as uncertain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Darkness, according to a reported contrary use.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is an attributed secondary usage contrasted with the primary morning meaning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Redness of the hair, according to a reported usage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An attributed color use related to the root's association with redness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A morning meal eaten between daybreak and sunrise.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A substantive use of the Form II verbal noun; its plural is used for morning meals served to guests.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The place or time of entering upon the morning.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun may denote the morning time, its onset, or the place associated with entering it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A large drinking vessel used for a morning draught.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized nominal use distinct from the lamp meaning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A she-camel that remains lying in the morning and does not go out to pasture until the sun is high.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The described condition is attributed to strength and fatness and is regarded as an approved quality.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A wide spearhead.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized object noun also reported for the related plural expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who drinks a morning draught.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The active participle refers to drinking the beverage called صَبُوح.

cautions: أَصْبَحَ has both a temporal morning use and a copular or resultative use meaning “became”; the surrounding construction determines the sense.
مِصْبَاحٌ is a lamp in singular contexts, while its Quranic plural مَصَابِيحُ can denote heavenly lights or stars.
Lane includes several rare, attributed, or specialized Classical uses; these are kept separate from Quran-attested meanings rather than generalized into them.
